page.overview:
Who is Kajika?

Kajika, once a shinobi of Kirigakure, turned missing-nin after leaving the village. During this period, Kajika formed connections with Orochimaru and Otogakure.

Kajika demonstrated unwavering loyalty to "Lord" Orochimaru, expressing a desire to be of service to someone he deeply respected. He affectionately referred to Orochimaru as "the Wonderful One". Additionally, Kajika exhibited a cruel disposition, seemingly deriving pleasure from combat, as evidenced by his actions, such as licking his lips during the fight with Sasuke.

Kajika sported short black hair, obscured by a distinctive grey shark-like top featuring a hood resembling a shark's head. The hood included an appendage at the back resembling a dorsal fin, paired with dark pants. Dark violet markings adorned beneath his green eyes, and at the edges of his mouth, Kajika bore two upward curving lines reminiscent of a Glasgow smile. Notably, he also possessed unusually long fingernails.

Kajika proved to be a formidable opponent, showcasing not only physical strength but also keen deductive skills. He quickly discerned Naruto and Sasuke's deception when they attempted to pose as his comrades.
